scenes.stage_direction: Rain, interrupted sleep and a missing infant. Preserve the distinction between Amara's true sighting and the unexplained means of entry.

dialogues.speaker: Detective Morris
dialogues.text: I have taken the witness's account. We will protect the person and preserve the original statement.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The witness remembers a service vehicle before the rain became heavy.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: No. We should not put that into their account.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Then tell me what they did see.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: A company mark and a staff coat. Both are things we can check. The witness will remain available.

metadata.episode: A continuing rescue mystery; the final clue opens the next episode.
